description: Widen `POST /servers`'s `ssh_keys` items to `integer | string`. The member's own description says "SSH key IDs (`integer`) or names (`string`)" and the API accepts both, but the schema declares `items: { type: string }` — so the generated input types the list as `Array<string>` and a caller holding the numeric ids the SSH Keys endpoints hand back cannot pass them without a cast. Every other id-or-name field in this spec (`POST /floating_ips`'s `home_location`, `POST /primary_ips`'s `location`) is spelled as the `oneOf` used here, which is what makes this one an authoring slip rather than a deliberate narrowing. Should upstream fix it, this patch goes stale and is reported (and can then be deleted) rather than silently corrupting the schema.
